title: Detailed Security Analysis of ZIP-GIFT
summary: ZIP-GIFT is identified as a concrete ZIP cipher, but no detailed security analysis is provided; developing one remains open.

formal_statement.body: ZIP-GIFT is a construction consisting of 14-round GIFT-64 followed by 14-round inverse GIFT-64. A detailed security analysis of ZIP-GIFT has not been provided, and developing such an analysis remains an open problem.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptanalysis of the ZIP-GIFT block-cipher construction.
parameters: 14-round GIFT-64 and 14-round inverse GIFT-64: the forward and inverse components of ZIP-GIFT
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop a detailed security analysis of ZIP-GIFT.

citations.label: General Practical Cryptanalysis of the Sum of Round-Reduced Block Ciphers and ZIP-AES

progress.summary: The source introduces ZIP-GIFT and explicitly says that, unlike ZIP-AES, it does not provide a detailed analysis, leaving that task open.
citation_labels: Antonio Florez Gutierrez et al., General Practical Cryptanalysis of the Sum of Round-Reduced Block Ciphers and ZIP-AES
